description:
Configure time-based routing for the 'Priority Support' inbound group. 

1. Create a new Call Time definition:
   - Call Time ID: 'PRISUP_HRS'
   - Description: 'Priority Support M-F 9-6'
   - Schedule: Monday-Friday 09:00 to 18:00, Closed on Saturday/Sunday.

2. Configure the existing Inbound Group 'PRISUP' (Priority Support):
   - Set the Call Time to the new 'PRISUP_HRS'.
   - Set the After Hours Action to 'VOICEMAIL'.
   - Set the After Hours Voicemail Box to '1000'.
   - Set the After Hours Message to 'vm-goodbye'.

Starting credentials: User 6666 / Password 'andromeda'.
